markdown:
Normal edit boxes have a toolbar above them to assist with making **bolded** or *italicized* text. The quickest way to input styled text, however, is to type in the appropriate syntax. A comprehensive guide to Wikidot's syntax can be found in the [Documentation](http://www.wikidot.com/doc-wiki-syntax:start). This page, however, can be used as a quick reference and should satisfy most textual needs.

| Syntax |  | Syntax |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **bold** |  | //italic// |
| __underline__ |  | ##red\|colored text## |
| + Heading |  | ++ Sub-heading |
| * Bulleted List |  | # Numbered List |
| [[[pagename \| Link to page]]] |  | [http://www.wikidot.com Link to site] |
| [[size smaller]]Smaller text[[/size]] |  | [[size larger]]Larger text[[/size]] |
| [[image SOURCE_URL]] |  | > Quoted text |
| [[<]]Align left[[/<]] |  | [[>]]Align right[[/>]] |
| [[=]]Center[[/=]] |  | [[==]]Justify[[/==]] |
